steps.en: Install the engine — add zod if you want runtime schema validation
steps.zh: 装上引擎，要运行时校验就再加 zod

steps.en: Declare a workflow: id, zod input/output, a plain async handler
steps.zh: 声明 workflow：输入输出用 zod，主体是普通函数

steps.en: Put side effects in ctx.step, long waits in ctx.approve
steps.zh: 副作用放进 ctx.step，长等待交给 ctx.approve

steps.en: Runs the handler, appends every finished step to the append-only log; a pause just returns
steps.zh: 执行 handler，完成事实逐条追加进日志；到等待点就返回

steps.en: Later, resume the same run from any process — deliver the approval or webhook payload
steps.zh: 之后从任意进程接着跑这个 run：把审批结果或回调载荷交回去

steps.en: Replays the log so recorded steps never re-execute, and the run continues past the pause
steps.zh: 重放日志：录过的步骤不再执行，流程从等待点之后继续

value.en: Day-long flows survive restarts — the charge runs once, waiting is a stored row, nothing re-executes
value.zh: 跨天的流程扛得住重启：扣款只执行一次，等待变成库里的行，没有重放也没有丢状态

sources: README.md Install section (pnpm add @tanstack/workflow-core) and Example section (createWorkflow, ctx.step('charge-card', ...), ctx.approve, runWorkflow); Core Ideas ("Side effects live inside `ctx.step(id, fn)`", "ctx.waitForEvent, ctx.approve, ctx.sleep")

docs/quick-start.md Install (pnpm add @tanstack/workflow-core zod) and Recipe: pause for human approval (runWorkflow({ workflow: order, runId, runStore: store, approval: { approvalId, approved: true } }))
docs/concepts/replay-and-resume.md ("Found → return the recorded result ... fn is NOT called"; resume re-runs the handler from the top)
docs/overview.md (mental model: append-only event log; runtime shape: @tanstack/workflow-core as the replay engine)
